stories.headline: Tech and space names lead a broad afternoon selloff while defense stocks rally
stories.one_line: One-day whipsaw, not a durable trend: defense and space both round-tripped through the week's remaining sessions with no consistent direction. Closing this thread; see Saturday's Weekly Review for the full week's sector rotation.
stories.score_note: Two-way whipsaw in defense (rally Tue, selloff Thu) and continued space weakness -- watching for whether either becomes a trend.
sources: this run's own Yahoo Finance close-series data

stories.headline: Meta's Oakland trial goes quiet Friday after a damaging week of testimony
stories.one_line: No courtroom activity found for Friday (federal calendars often dark Fridays). Week's substance stands: Bejar's Tue/Wed testimony plus a former engineering director's Wednesday testimony that Zuckerberg prioritized growth over child safety. Zuckerberg remains a listed future witness, no date set, no public response yet.
stories.score_note: No new movement; recap only.

stories.headline: Gomez's accuser directly disputes his 'consensual' account via her attorneys
stories.one_line: No new statement from Gomez, the Ethics Committee, or Democratic leadership since Wednesday's attorney statement. No material movement.
stories.score_note: Direct on-record rebuttal from accuser's counsel; credibility dispute now squarely public.

stories.headline: Canada tariff deadline hits at midnight with a deal reportedly close but still unsigned
stories.one_line: Resolved: Prime Minister Carney suspended negotiations minutes before the extended deadline, and the paused 50% Section 338 tariffs on roughly $20B of Canadian goods took effect just after midnight Saturday Aug 22, as scheduled. No deal, no further extension. Forecasts on this outcome graded wrong (deal/extension had been the higher-probability call).
stories.score_note: Closed. Third deadline approached this cycle; none produced a signed deal.

stories.headline: Bessent formalizes 'economic D-Day' against Iran; gold futures run further, oil mixed
stories.one_line: Bessent's full 'Economic D-Day' sanctions package is detailed Monday 2:00 PM ET -- secondary sanctions pressuring banks/firms/governments (China named as Iran's largest oil buyer) to cut ties with Iran. Iran's Foreign Ministry pre-emptively rejected it as unlawful; SNSC secretary Rezaei threatened to halt all Gulf oil traffic if any neighboring state joins the campaign. Package contents unconfirmed pending Monday's announcement.
stories.score_note: Central story entering next week -- Monday's sanctions detail is the next concrete checkpoint.

stories.headline: DRC Ebola outbreak 'spreading faster and wider' than ever, UN warns, as response funding runs low
stories.one_line: Case count reached 5,290/2,516 dead by Aug 19 (46-47% case-fatality rate), the largest outbreak in DRC history. UN Senior Ebola Coordinator Julien Harneis says growth is exponential and response funding may run out within weeks -- a funding-shortfall warning layered on top of the PHEIC extension confirmed the same week.
stories.score_note: Accelerating with an explicit funding-shortfall warning; keep at high cadence.
sources: WHO situation report and Emergency Committee statement (primary)

stories.headline: Mail-ballot SCOTUS emergency docket remains fully briefed with no ruling
stories.one_line: Fully briefed for over a week; Solicitor General has told justices it is 'critical that the Court act promptly.' No ruling as of Thursday morning. Tracked alongside the ballroom case as the Court's second live emergency docket.
stories.score_note: No new movement; still shadow-docket risk.

stories.headline: EU and UK edge toward sanctions over E1 as Israel opens first criminal probes of the war
stories.one_line: Israel's E1 tender is now specified at 1,234 units. UK summoned Israel's charge d'affaires Aug 19; Miliband says a 'comprehensive sanctions package' is coming within weeks, not yet enacted by EU or UK. IDF opened its first-ever criminal investigations into the Hind Rajab killing (now admits its own troops fired on the vehicle) and the killing of 15 Red Crescent paramedics. Disarmament sequencing dispute remains unresolved; Hamas has not confirmed a response to the reported US-general-supervised handover framework.
stories.score_note: First formal IDF criminal accountability step of the war on either killing.

stories.headline: Trump says he hasn't discussed Fauci prosecution with Blanche or Pirro; DOJ still reviewing the contempt referral
stories.one_line: Trump told reporters Aug 10-11 (per Semafor's Shelby Talcott) he has 'not spoken' to AG Blanche or DC US Attorney Pirro about prosecuting Fauci, tempering earlier suggestions Fauci could face Bannon/Navarro-style contempt charges. DOJ says it is 'reviewing' the Aug 6 referral; no charging decision announced.
stories.score_note: First real test of how the Blanche DOJ handles the referral; Trump's statement is a data point, not a signal of the eventual decision either way.

stories.headline: Tigray fighting remains in a tentative, single-sourced lull
stories.one_line: Forecast graded correct: no expansion to new fronts and no fresh formal AU/UN mediation statement through Aug 21. Downgrading tracking cadence given sustained containment.
stories.score_note: Low cadence tracking continues.

stories.headline: Chang'e 7 window refined to Aug 23 8PM ET; Long March 7A root cause still unpublished
stories.one_line: Live self-correction: Chang'e 7 has not launched as of Sunday morning. Launch Library 2's own schedule now specifies net 2026-08-25T00:30:00Z (8:30 PM ET Monday Aug 24), a one-day slip from this report's prior Sunday estimate, still within the daily-repeating window through Aug 31. Long March 7A root-cause finding still unpublished.
stories.score_note: Launch-window correction plus an inferential (not confirmed) data point on the open investigation.

stories.headline: SpaceX's ~319M-share unlock arrives today -- a correction to this report's own prior tracking
stories.one_line: Event fully resolved: the ~319M-share unlock produced a muted -4.05% reaction (Aug 20) and a +2.22% recovery (Aug 21), well inside the volatility the market had priced. All related forecasts graded this week (2 correct, 3 wrong on the >5%-move calls). No further unlock scheduled; closing this thread.
stories.score_note: Event has now occurred; no further tracking needed unless a new unlock tranche is scheduled.
sources: this run's own FINRA short-volume computation

stories.headline: Home Depot falls 2.9% after CEO Ted Decker takes temporary medical leave; two executives named to oversee operations
stories.one_line: Decker's medical-leave timeline remains undisclosed beyond the original 'a few months' guidance. Forecast graded correct: HD did not fall a further 3% attributable to the leave news, helped by Tuesday's earnings beat (adj. EPS $4.92 vs. ~$4.72 est.).
stories.score_note: Forecast 2026-08-12-pm-3 logged on whether HD falls a further 3%+ over the next 5 sessions.
sources: this run's own Twelve Data close-series data

stories.headline: VMware vCenter deadline lands today amid China-nexus attribution and ransomware escalation
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple (campaign scale); Single-reliable-source, moderate confidence (China-nexus attribution)
stories.one_line: CISA added CVE-2026-59310 to the KEV catalog Aug 18 (forecast graded correct); the federal civilian remediation deadline landed Friday Aug 21 with compliance confirmation still pending (typically surfaces days later via CISA/GAO reporting). Moderate-confidence China-nexus attribution and Babuk-ransomware-on-ESXi escalation both stand.
stories.score_note: Deadline-day story with a genuine new escalation (ransomware on hypervisors); attribution stays single-firm/moderate confidence.

stories.headline: Roberts stays the ballroom injunction hours before it would have taken effect
stories.one_line: Chief Justice Roberts issued an administrative stay Friday allowing construction to resume -- not a merits ruling. Both forecasts betting on timely Court action graded correct. The fuller emergency application remains before the full Court with no timeline; keeping this open until a merits disposition.
stories.score_note: First concrete SCOTUS action of the week on either live emergency docket.

stories.headline: Mangione's Manhattan murder trial postponed over the double-jeopardy motion
stories.one_line: Judge Gregory Carro postponed the Sept 8 trial date, gave the Manhattan DA until Oct 9 to respond to the double-jeopardy motion, with a hearing set for Dec 10 (roughly a week before Mangione's Dec 18 federal sentencing). DA's office says it remains 'prepared to litigate' and intends to keep pursuing the state case. Separate-sovereigns doctrine gives the defense a steep hurdle.
stories.score_note: Concrete judicial action with clear next dates (Oct 9, Dec 10).

stories.headline: Flores earthquake toll jumps to 83 as displacement figures emerge
stories.one_line: Indonesia's BNPB, via Xinhua, now puts the toll at 83 with ~100,000 displaced and nearly 45,000 homes damaged -- well above the ~68-70 range other trackers (PBS, CBS) still show as of their last update. Not yet cross-confirmed by a second outlet at 83.
stories.score_note: Toll climbing and not yet reconciled across outlets -- worth continued tracking.

stories.headline: Coldcard ships patched firmware; AI-assisted audit surfaces thousands of bugs across the ecosystem
stories.one_line: Coinkite shipped patched firmware and disclosed an AI-assisted 'Bitcoin Red Team' audit of 390 projects found 4,962 issues (85 critical, 635 high) in 24 hours, feeding a separate BTCPay patch; up to 3 BTC bounty offered for stolen-fund return, 0.42 BTC already paid to researchers. Losses now cited $112-116M, a modest revision within the prior range. Sourced to CoinDesk only so far.
stories.score_note: Genuine new development; needs a second-outlet confirmation.

stories.headline: Merck/Moderna melanoma vaccine draws independent praise as a 'landmark'; mRNA sector rallies further
stories.one_line: Moderna whipsawed all week (+177% Wed, -23.55% Thu, higher again Fri) on trader repositioning around still-topline-only Phase 3 data -- no hazard ratios/CIs disclosed, not yet peer-reviewed. Merck held its gains better. Watching for the full data publication.
stories.score_note: Rally giving back a quarter of itself in one session is itself informative about how much was durable conviction vs. momentum.

stories.headline: UAE-Iran trade suspension holds with no de-escalation reported
stories.one_line: No movement toward escalation or de-escalation since Wednesday's suspension.
stories.score_note: No material change; watch for any Iranian response.

stories.headline: Broadcom draws a bullish initiation and reported $100B AI financing talks as Marvell pulls back
stories.one_line: BMO initiated Broadcom at Outperform, $455 PT, helping shares recover 1-2% intraday. Broadcom is reportedly in talks with lenders for financing as large as $100B tied to AI infrastructure -- not yet corroborated elsewhere. Marvell fell 5.57% today with no company-specific news found, giving back part of its recent run.
stories.score_note: Financing-talks figure needs a second source before treating as confirmed.

stories.headline: Softer 20-year auction and Treasury buybacks pull yields down into Thursday's 30-year reopening
stories.one_line: Auction cycle closed for the week. Treasury's doubled buyback program (to $4B+/operation, beginning Sept 9) is now a standing policy fact folded into the weekly rates narrative rather than a discrete item needing its own watch entry.
stories.score_note: Buyback effect proved temporary; yields backed right up the next session.

stories.headline: Turkey issues arrest warrant for Netanyahu as Idlib-area strike target is confirmed as Abu al-Duhur
stories.one_line: Reporting now identifies Abu al-Duhur airbase (~70km from Turkey) as the target, which Israel says was being retrofitted for Turkish forces; Turkey denies any troop presence and has issued an arrest warrant for Netanyahu. No new strikes since Thursday.
stories.score_note: Formal Turkish legal action (arrest warrant) is a real escalation in rhetoric/posture, though not in kinetic activity.

stories.headline: Trump-endorsed primary losses reach ten this cycle as Rep. Cory Mills is ousted
stories.one_line: Mills lost FL-7 to Ryan Elijah (~46-34%) amid an ethics probe, restraining order, and ex-girlfriend allegations. Trump said via Truth Social he told Mills to 'get out' but never publicly rescinded his Feb endorsement before the loss. Outlets frame this as 10 Trump-endorsed 2026 primary losses, tying the combined 2018+2020+2024 total.
stories.score_note: First hard data point on limits of Trump primary-endorsement influence heading into midterms.

stories.headline: FBI's Swalwell investigation widens: four women say agents have contacted them
stories.one_line: Sharp escalation over the weekend: FBI agents intercepted Swalwell at SFO Saturday evening and seized his devices (iPhone, MacBook Pro) under a search warrant, then searched his D.C. home Sunday. Still an investigation -- no arrest, no charges. At least four accusers now reportedly contacted by the FBI.
stories.score_note: Scope of the investigation (accuser count) is growing even without charges yet.

stories.headline: Anthropic's training-pause stance draws IPO-timing scrutiny
stories.one_line: Critics now tie the February 2026 policy shift's timing to Anthropic's confidential IPO filing (~4 days later) and $65B raise at a $965B valuation (~8 days later). Separate single-sourced reporting says Anthropic could file to go public as soon as end of August at ~$65B annualized revenue -- not yet independently confirmed.
stories.score_note: Credibility-pressure framing intensifies; underlying safety-governance divergence from OpenAI unchanged.

stories.headline: Federal agencies warn of an active AI-generated-malware campaign against Siemens industrial control systems
stories.one_line: CISA/NSA/FBI/DOE/EPA joint advisory AA26-231a: attackers scan for internet-exposed Siemens S7 PLCs, then deploy AI-generated Python scripts disguised as monitoring tools to read/modify controller logic across water, energy and manufacturing facilities. No formal attribution despite some outlets noting suspected Iran links to related water-sector intrusions; no confirmed disruption reported.
stories.score_note: One of the first federal disclosures of AI-generated code used operationally against critical infrastructure.

stories.headline: Wave of Walmart price-target cuts underscores the tariff-refund pattern seen across retail earnings
stories.one_line: Seven brokerages cut Walmart price targets Friday citing the 2.6% comp-growth deceleration (slowest since 2020), mostly keeping bullish ratings -- a valuation reset, not a thesis change. The Deere/Walmart same-day contrast (both beat, one jumped, one cratered) is this week's clearest lesson on tariff-refund-flattered headline numbers; forecast on retail broadly beating graded correct.
stories.score_note: Sell-side response to Wednesday's plunge now on record; confirms this is read as a growth-rate story, not a franchise-health scare.

stories.headline: Missouri judge upholds GOP-drawn congressional map, blocks referendum effort
stories.one_line: Plaintiffs' attorneys have signaled intent to appeal directly to the Missouri Supreme Court, with a sitting justice reportedly urging speed ahead of the Sept 8 ballot-printing deadline. No formal appeal filing confirmed yet.
stories.score_note: Low-priority Overnight item, not escalated to a Top Story.

stories.headline: Trump nominates Dr. Heidi Overton for FDA Commissioner
stories.one_line: Sen. Patty Murray has said she will vote no; Sen. Bill Cassidy has voiced concerns without committing. No committee hearing date set. No other material movement.
stories.score_note: Nomination announced right at/after the prior edition's cutoff; may need reconciling if already noted elsewhere.

stories.headline: Rocket Lab's Electron launches successfully, deploys ninth iQPS SAR satellite
stories.one_line: Electron launched from Mahia, New Zealand early Friday local time (~9:04 AM ET Thu), successfully deploying the ninth QPS-SAR Earth-imaging satellite for Japan's iQPS constellation. Closes a previously-tracked launch-schedule thread with no further action needed.
stories.score_note: Clean mission success; no further tracking required.

stories.headline: Russia's 'double-tap' Kryvyi Rih strike kills six, wounds ~91
stories.one_line: Toll converged to 16 dead / ~140 wounded (from Saturday's disputed 6-16+ range), still Ukrainian-official-sourced. Fresh strikes continued through the weekend on both sides: Russia killed 6 more Saturday, a Sunday drone/missile alert hit Kyiv and Zaporizhzhia; an unverified Russian-Telegram-sourced claim of a Ukrainian strike on an Orenburg logistics center has no Western corroboration. Putin has warned of 'far more destructive' strikes ahead.
stories.score_note: New casualty event distinct from the already-tracked Kyiv barrage.

stories.headline: Somali pirates hijack an Iran shadow-fleet tanker as regional piracy hits a 10-year high
stories.one_line: Somali pirates hijacked the tanker Sibu 1 (also tracked as Seamull, a US-sanctioned vessel linked to Iran's shadow fleet) off Yemen Thursday -- the second hijacking in four days and, per UKMTO, near a decade-high regional piracy rate. Not directly tied to the US-Iran standoff but worth watching alongside this week's sanctions escalation.
stories.score_note: Possible secondary pressure point in the Iran standoff via shadow-fleet shipping.

stories.headline: Canada's 50% tariffs take effect after Carney suspends talks minutes before deadline
stories.one_line: Prime Minister Carney suspended negotiations minutes before the extended deadline; the paused Section 338 tariffs on roughly $20B of Canadian goods (including cement and hockey sticks) took effect just after midnight ET Saturday. Reported terms (autos to 15%, steel/aluminum halved, dairy protected) remain unsigned. Third deadline this cycle to pass without a finished text.
stories.score_note: Closes out the week's central trade-policy cliffhanger as a miss for the 'deal gets done' framing that dominated Friday's coverage.

stories.headline: Bitcoin posts its biggest weekly gain since March 2024 as it tops $77,000
stories.one_line: The ~22% weekly gain survived a sharp flash crash early Saturday (~04:00 UTC): BTC fell from a ~$79,500 intraday high to ~$76,500 within six minutes, the sharpest crypto flash crash since October 2025 per multiple crypto-market outlets (liquidations ~$1.7-1.8B over 24h; a widely-circulated $108B figure is crypto-blog-sourced and not corroborated by mainstream financial press). As of Sunday morning BTC trades near $77,300, still up ~20-22% for the week but the rally has not held cleanly.
stories.score_note: The only market trading this weekend; watch whether the move holds into Monday's cash-equity open.

stories.headline: Anthropic's IPO paperwork will reportedly list AI backlash as a formal risk factor
stories.one_line: CNBC reported Friday, citing people familiar with the matter, that Anthropic's confidentially filed S-1 will list AI-driven public/political backlash as a formal risk factor. Sits alongside separately-sourced, longer-running reporting of an October listing target near a $2T valuation -- which would exceed SpaceX's June IPO debut.
stories.score_note: Single-sourced on the specific risk-factor detail; the broader IPO trajectory is better corroborated.

stories.headline: Federal judge strikes down the administration's 75-country visa suspension
stories.one_line: Judge Jeannette Vargas (S.D.N.Y.) ruled Friday the suspension of immigrant-visa processing for 75 countries exceeded Secretary Rubio's statutory authority by discriminating by nationality rather than individualized assessment. Administration has not said whether it will appeal.
stories.score_note: New ruling; watch for an appeal decision this week.

stories.headline: South Carolina Senate primary runoff Tuesday tests Trump's endorsement strength
stories.one_line: Darline Graham (Trump-endorsed) vs. Ralph Norman for the late Sen. Lindsey Graham's seat; Graham led the first round 33-24%. Winner advances to the Nov 3 special general against Democrat Annie Andrews. Comes after 10 Trump-endorsed primary losses this cycle.
stories.score_note: Dated election event this week; the week's one confirmed political vote.

stories.headline: Nvidia's Wednesday earnings are the week's single largest scheduled market catalyst
stories.one_line: Reports Wed Aug 26 after close (call 5:00 PM ET). EPS consensus $2.01-2.13 across Alpha Vantage/Finnhub; trade-press revenue consensus ~$93-95B. Marvell reports the next day (Thu), a direct read on the Google TPU deal/Broadcom-exclusivity dispute.
stories.score_note: Central market event of the week; forecast logged on the magnitude of the after-hours move.
